# AZMX Color Reference - Test Fixture

Simplified color reference for testing brand-check.py

## Primary

| Token | Hex | Usage |
|---|---|---|
| Electric | `#001AFF` | Hero accent, call-to-attention |
| Dark Navy | `#040038` | Premium dark surface |
| Light Blue | `#5D8FFF` | Dark-surface accent partner |
| White | `#FFFFFF` | Editorial light workhorse surface |
